# Synthetic ECON101 syllabus

This invented engineering course studies marginal choices and causal experiments.
Week 03 covers incremental contribution, sunk costs, randomized tests and uncertainty.
For class, read both assigned readings, distinguish assumptions from observations,
and bring discussion points about evidence that could change a decision.

Preparation briefs should include Overview, Reading synthesis, Key concepts,
Preparation questions, Discussion points and Sources. Show executed arithmetic
when deriving quantitative values, cite supplied materials, and flag missing data.

AI assistance is explicitly permitted for preparation, full assignment drafts,
discussion and review in this synthetic fixture. No submission is authorized.
Assignments may specify a different output format or scope; preserve those rules.
The syllabus does not specify grading weights, attendance requirements or exam rules.
